notes: Version 2.0 withdraws the claim that Hypothesis 4.4, the canonical admissible embedding of the pair vectors into V_rho, was resolved unconditionally by O27. O27 supplies the canonical representation action under the carrier that O23 provides conditionally; it does not furnish the required vector lift. An equivariant adjoint-factorising realisation is excluded, since there is no non-zero su(2)-equivariant map from the adjoint to the fundamental; a quotient-factorising linear lift that is not equivariant is not excluded, so Hypothesis 4.4 remains open in that wider class. The final arrow of the implication chain is the carrier supplied conditionally by O23, not a consequence of the three constraints.
